# 2026-09-01 18:46:02, the worst case in the whole log. The case had been off the air for
# 2395 s. The hand opened it, and everything it said was one shut word repeated 27 times over
# 3.5 s - lid 0x39, counter 1, Apple's explicit bit set on every copy - and then silence. There
# was no open word to wait for, which is why 0.8.14 showed nothing at all here.
#
# 0.8.15 shows the popup on the first word, because a case that has been quiet that long does
# not start talking on its own. The repeats that follow cannot take it away: they are the same
# word the popup was raised on. When the case stops talking the popup goes 2500 ms later.

!shapes 49,39
!expect shows 1
!expect hides 1
!expect show-after-wake-within-ms 200
!expect popup-lives-at-least-ms 3000
